meta_data.base_class: search for events within a specific <calendar platform> - these platforms all support keyword and time-range based schedule queries.

tool_template.name: search_<class>_events
tool_template.description: Searches a user's <class> for events that match a given query string.

query.description: The query string used to search for <class> events.

time_hint.description: A hint to narrow the search within a specific time window, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

timezone.description: The timezone in which the events should be searched, formatted as an IANA time zone identifier, e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'.

include_recurring.description: Boolean value indicating whether to include recurring events in the search results within the <class>.

max_results.description: The maximum number of events search results to return.

event_type_filter.description: Types of events to filter during the search, such as 'meeting', 'reminder', 'appointment', etc.
